beats.event: Time Traveller demos a model machine to dinner guests
A week later he recounts his journey
Discovers the childlike Eloi amid deteriorating buildings
Notes the Eloi are content but lack curiosity and fear the dark
Returns to arrival point; his machine is gone
Encounters the ape-like Morlocks living underground
Realizes the Morlocks abduct and eat the Eloi at night
Travels to a derelict museum to arm himself
Morlock attack; his fire spreads into a forest fire
Weena consumed by fire along with the Morlocks
Morlocks use the Sphinx statue to trap him
He retrieves his machine and escapes
Travels ~30 million years forward, sees Earth dying
Returns home three hours after his departure
Presents white flowers from Weena as evidence
Sets out on another journey and never returns
